title: Facture obligatoire entre professionnels
validation: A legally invoiceable B2B transaction has an invoice.

title: Date d'émission obligatoire
validation: issue_date IS NOT NULL

title: Numéro de facture obligatoire
validation: number IS NOT NULL

title: Numéro de facture unique
validation: number is unique within legal entity and numbering series

title: Séquence chronologique continue
validation: number belongs to a chronological continuous auditable series

title: Identification du vendeur
validation: all seller identity fields required for the legal form are present

title: Identification du client
validation: customer name and required billing identity/address are present

title: Date de livraison/prestation lorsque requise
validation: operation_date is present

title: Désignation précise des lignes
validation: each invoice line has a meaningful description

title: Quantité et unité lorsqu'applicables
validation: quantity and unit are present and coherent

title: Prix unitaire HT
validation: unit_price_ex_vat is present

title: Réductions de prix traçables
validation: discount amount/rate and calculation are explicit

title: Cohérence HT/TVA/TTC
validation: total_ex_vat + total_vat = total_inc_vat within configured rounding

title: Conditions et échéance de paiement
validation: due date/terms are present

title: Mention des pénalités de retard B2B
validation: late-payment terms are displayed

title: Indemnité forfaitaire de recouvrement de 40 €
validation: EUR 40 recovery indemnity mention is present

title: Devise explicite
validation: currency is valid and consistent across amounts

title: Immutabilité financière après émission
validation: financial and legal fields are not destructively overwritten

title: Journal d'audit
validation: status changes, corrections and key calculations are attributable and timestamped

title: Avoir relié au document corrigé
applies_if: document.type=CREDIT_NOTE AND it corrects an existing invoice
validation: original invoice reference is retained

title: Correction de TVA par l'avoir
validation: tax correction follows the applicable original VAT treatment
effect: Generate VAT deltas by tax bucket.

title: Demande, facture et paiement d'acompte séparés
validation: deposit request, deposit invoice and deposit payment are distinct events

title: Pas de double imputation d'acompte
applies_if: deposit is offset on final invoice
validation: one deposit allocation cannot be consumed twice

title: Affectation explicite des paiements
validation: invoice settlement uses allocation records

title: Pas de sur-affectation paiement
validation: sum(allocations) <= payment amount

title: Solde client déterministe
validation: open balance reconciles issued total, payments and credits

title: Traitement TVA explicite par ligne
validation: line VAT treatment is explicit: taxable rate / exemption / franchise / reverse charge / out-of-scope

title: Ventilation TVA par taux/régime
validation: taxable bases and taxes are grouped by treatment/rate

title: Mention TVA spéciale
validation: required legal mention/reference is selected

title: Politique d'arrondi déterministe
validation: one configured rounding policy is applied consistently
effect: Persist calculation precision and final rounding.

title: TVA négative adossée à une correction
validation: negative VAT is backed by a credit/correction event

title: Référentiel PCG version 2026
applies_if: posting period uses 2026 French accounting rules
validation: mapping is compatible with effective PCG

title: Événement comptable équilibré
validation: sum(debits)=sum(credits)

title: Comptes configurables
applies_if: posting maps semantic events to accounts
validation: accounts are resolved by mapping/rules, not one global hardcode

title: Réception e-factures au 1er septembre 2026
validation: system supports receipt through an approved platform

title: Émission e-factures GE/ETI
applies_if: seller.size IN [GE,ETI] AND transaction in scope
validation: invoice emitted using mandated electronic channel/format

title: Émission e-factures PME/micro
applies_if: seller.size IN [PME,MICRO] AND transaction in scope
validation: invoice emitted using mandated electronic channel/format

title: PDF e-mail seul insuffisant pour l'e-invoicing obligatoire
validation: invoice uses required structured/standardized electronic form and approved transmission channel

title: Nouvelles données obligatoires liées à la réforme
applies_if: seller reaches its applicable reform date
validation: required additional structured fields are present

title: Montant initial du marché
validation: original_contract_amount_ex_vat >= 0

title: Montant courant du marché
validation: current amount = original amount + approved price-impacting changes

title: Cycle de vie des avenants
validation: status IN [DRAFT,APPROVED,REJECTED,CANCELLED]

title: Seuls les avenants approuvés impactent la base
validation: only APPROVED amendments impact billable contract base

title: Modèle cumulatif des situations
validation: current cumulative is derived from approved contract lines/progress

title: Cumul précédent issu des situations validées
validation: previous cumulative equals validated ledger/history, not free input

title: Période = cumul courant - cumul précédent
validation: period_ex_vat = current_cumulative_ex_vat - previous_validated_cumulative_ex_vat

title: Pas de dépassement sans base approuvée
validation: current cumulative <= approved billable contract base unless explicit authorized adjustment

title: Pas de baisse silencieuse du cumul
validation: current cumulative >= previous cumulative OR an explicit correction workflow exists

title: Rapprochement final du marché
validation: final position reconciles contract, approved changes, situations, credits, advances and retentions

title: Avance distincte de l'avancement physique
validation: advance payment does not itself change physical progress

title: Récupération d'avance selon règles contractuelles
validation: recovery method/thresholds are explicit and versioned
effect: Do not invent a generic recovery rule.

title: Retenue privée seulement si prévue au contrat
validation: retention is applied only when contractually stipulated and statutory scope applies

title: Plafond 5 % retenue privée
validation: retention_rate <= 0.05

title: Consignation de la retenue privée
validation: compliance workflow records statutory consignation or qualifying substitute

title: Garantie substitutive à la retenue
validation: withholding is not practiced when statutory substitute conditions are met

title: Libération à un an sous conditions
validation: eligibility evaluated one year after reception and accounts for timely motivated opposition

title: Autoliquidation sous-traitance travaux immobiliers
applies_if: supplier is subcontractor AND buyer is taxable AND operation is qualifying immovable-property work
validation: supplier does not collect VAT and reverse-charge treatment is applied
effect: Set REVERSE_CHARGE treatment and required wording.
source_title: Autoliquidation TVA des travaux immobiliers sous-traités

title: Pas d'autoliquidation par simple étiquette BTP
validation: transaction-level conditions are checked
source_title: Autoliquidation TVA des travaux immobiliers sous-traités

title: Taux réduits rénovation logement ancien
applies_if: works may qualify for reduced housing-renovation VAT
validation: 5.5% or 10% only when all applicable conditions are proven
effect: Run eligibility engine; otherwise do not guess a reduced rate.
source_title: Taux de TVA pour rénovation d'un logement

title: Réception structurée
validation: reception_date and reservation status are stored

title: Suivi des réserves
validation: reservations carry status/dates/evidence

title: Révision de prix issue du contrat
validation: formula, base month, indices and rounding are explicit/versioned

title: Traçabilité des indices
validation: index values, source, date and formula version are retained

title: Facturation au secteur public via Chorus Pro
applies_if: recipient is public entity and applicable flow requires Chorus
validation: invoice is transmitted through required public invoicing channel

title: Avance distincte de l'acompte
validation: advance and progress instalment are modeled as distinct event types
source_title: Demander le paiement et facturer un marché public

title: Acompte mensuel lorsque le droit applicable le prévoit
applies_if: holder/market category is entitled to monthly instalments
validation: contract/payment schedule supports applicable periodicity
source_title: Demander le paiement et facturer un marché public

title: Objet de la retenue publique limité aux réserves
validation: retention is used only for statutory guarantee purpose
source_title: Code de la commande publique R2191-32 à R2191-35

title: Plafond général de 5 % en marché public
applies_if: public retention applies AND special SME cap does not apply
validation: retention_rate <= 0.05
source_title: Code de la commande publique R2191-32 à R2191-35

title: Plafond de 3 % pour certaines PME
applies_if: holder is SME AND buyer matches R2191-33 categories/thresholds
validation: retention_rate <= 0.03
source_title: Code de la commande publique R2191-32 à R2191-35

title: Base de calcul de la retenue publique
validation: basis = initial market amount + applicable modifications in execution
source_title: Code de la commande publique R2191-32 à R2191-35

title: Prélèvement fractionné
validation: withholding is allocated over instalments/partial final settlements/balance as applicable
source_title: Code de la commande publique R2191-32 à R2191-35

title: Remboursement de la retenue publique
validation: refund timing accounts for statutory period and unresolved reservations
source_title: Code de la commande publique R2191-32 à R2191-35
